settings.heading: Find your size.
settings.intro: Every jersey is cut to the same block, so a size in one design is the same size in all of them. Measurements are of the garment, laid flat, in centimetres.
settings.notes:
Chest is measured straight across the garment from one underarm seam to the other. Length runs from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem.

Between two sizes, take the larger one. The cut is meant to sit loose, the way a shirt does on the terraces rather than on the pitch.
